**WC-PENDING-01 is explicitly approved as a new, bounded evidence allocation:**

This allocation neither borrows nor enlarges the prior OMA, TAC-10 or Consecration allocations.

The corrected blood-age interpretation is consistent with the inspected implementation: 14,400 seconds begins Degraded; 28,800 begins Spoiled. Every new route must retain its actual timing and age calculations.

My review was read-only. I read the definition, complete contract, bindings, audit, planning checks, validator source and independent review; inspected the relevant profile/restore, authority, filling, mining, research, manufacturing and predecessor-test code. I independently verified all **64 pinned inputs** by size, SHA-256 and Git blob identity, checked the **12 historical source inputs** against their original revision, and matched **30 engine/host/test inputs** to the retained Candidate02 source archive. The supplied contract, definition and bindings hashes matched.

I did **not** repeat the 485-file availability scan, run the planning validator, compile, execute gameplay/tests, benchmark or requalify an accepted module.

With this agreement retained and Codex concurrence recorded, implementation may proceed for **this module only**.
